name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 超サイヤ人ベジット

ja: Figure-rise Standard 超サイヤ人ベジットがパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
• 最大約450mmのビッグスケール！
約65mmの貫かれているブウとベジットソードが付属。
• 特徴的な配色の胴着と手袋や靴などは成形色で再現。
• 各関節の可動と肩の引き出し、腰の前屈により、劇中のバトルシーンを再現可能。
• ベジットソードは4つのパーツで長さを調整可能。
en: Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan Vegito is now available with a renewed package! !
• Big Scale of up to about 450mm!
Buu and Vegetto Sword, which have been pierced approximately 65mm, are included.
• The characteristic color scheme of the body, gloves, and shoes are reproduced in molded colors.
• By moving each joint, pulling out the shoulders, and bending the waist forward, you can recreate the battle scenes from the movie.
• The length of Vegetto Sword can be adjusted with 4 parts.

ja: 表情パーツ2種（平常、叫び）×各1
en: 2 types of facial expression parts (normal, screaming) x 1 each
7 types of wrist parts x 1 each
